attributes.action: I Demand that the Current UK Government Calls for an Immediate General Election
attributes.additional_details: In these highly dangerous times, and as an vastly unpopular and 'unelected' PM, I'd expect him to have the honour and decency to allow the British people to choose who we'd like running our country and how we'd like to deal with the BIGGER issues, affecting our daily lives.
attributes.background: After continuing to ignore the concerns of a large section of the British people, by continuing to allow hordes of undocumented foreign nationals to arrive on our shores, genuinely putting many lives at risk, this government is failing to carry out it's basic duty to protect the British people

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
